name: pmdemod
comment: Sig: x = pmdemod(y, fc, fs, phasedev[, ini_phase]). Phase demodulator (inverse of pmmod): x = angle(hilbert(y).*exp(-1j*(2*pi*fc*t+ini_phase)))/phasedev. Fingerprint: pmdemod(pmmod(cos(2*pi*t),10,100,2),10,100,2) -> mp(1)=0.9999999905, mp(2)=0.9980267084, mp(50)=-0.9980267084 (recovers the message). Depends on the length-N hilbert (bugs/signal/hilbert-nonpow2 fix). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b. Fixes the pmdemod part of bugs/comm/analog-demodulators.
